scenes.caption: Make time for regular practice
scenes.narration_line: Practise simple relaxation regularly during pregnancy to become familiar with the technique.

scenes.caption: Place your hands around your lower ribs
scenes.narration_line: Rest your hands along your lower ribcage, with your fingertips just touching.

scenes.caption: Breathe in slowly through your nose
scenes.narration_line: Take a slow breath in through your nose; notice your fingertips move slightly apart.

scenes.caption: Let your breath out slowly
scenes.narration_line: Breathe out through your mouth just as slowly, noticing your fingertips come together again.

scenes.caption: Repeat the slow, steady pattern
scenes.narration_line: Continue practising slow breathing in and out, keeping this a simple relaxation exercise.
